_about: Sulfolane (1) + Toluene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of sulfolane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of sulfolane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Wang, Z.[Zhengrong], Huang, L.[Lei], Xia, S.[Shuqian], Ma, P.[Peisheng], Isobaric (vapour + liquid) equilibria for sulfolane with toluene, ethylbenzene, and isopropylbenzene at 101.33 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 43 (2011) 1865-1869
